The '''Prototype Director Droid DX-11''' was an advanced version of the [[Director Droid DX-10]] produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]]. A number of DX-11 droids were in storage in the Research and Development section of the [[Okara Droid Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].
